sources.title: 6l3m/kairos-quality-intent · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: kairos-quality-intent A fine-tune of FunctionGemma-270M-it that reads a video edit request written in plain words ("give it more of a film feel", "the voice is hard to hear") and names the quality intents it asks for, from a closed list of 30 ids, or none. It runs in the browser in the kaairos video editor (transformers.js, WebGPU), where it is consulted only on a request no word rule ...

sources.title: GitHub - DAXIAORobotics/kairos: Official code for world model Kairos
sources.snippet: Powered by a World-Action Model architecture and hybrid linear temporal memory, Kairos jointly predicts future visual states and executable robot actions, enabling long-horizon reasoning, high-quality generation, and real-time edge-side deployment for embodied AI.

sources.title: Kairos AI - AI Companion for Healthy Aging - GitHub
sources.snippet: AI for Healthy and Clear-Minded Aging with Advanced Memory, Security, and Cultural Intelligence Welcome to Kairos! This project provides a comprehensive AI platform that combines long-term memory, privacy-centric processing, cognitive enhancement training, multimodal integration, and cultural optimization to support healthy aging and cognitive health.

sources.title: MusicLM - AI Model for Music Generation
sources.snippet: MusicLM is an AI music generation model creating melodies from text prompts, backed by an extensive dataset of curated music-text pairs.
